_about: Tool map for ReconQA's built-in TestRail helper (drivers/testrail/server.mjs), used by the write gate. Any tool on this server that is not listed is denied. Uploads take only a batch id from a preview the user has seen; the helper only adds cases, runs and results.

ask_reasons.testrail_upload: sends the previewed batch to TestRail (adds cases, or a test run with results). Check the batch id matches the preview you agreed to

tested_with: reconqa-testrail 0.1.0 (built in); TestRail API v2 from the public docs, not yet live-tested
